showcaseAssistantModesDescription: The assistant's 4 modes (styleguide data: name, tagline, principle, example, color classes).
showcaseAutocompleteDescription: Material 3 capsule — single or multiple selection (chips), on-the-fly creation, loading state, customizable rendering and texts.
showcaseCardModalDescription: Generic modal whose container is any of the card variants above — freely combine variant, animation, and draggable.
showcaseCascadingNavDescription: Cascading navigation dropdown, opens downward or upward based on the direction prop.
showcaseCircularGalleryDescription: Circular-pill gallery (GSAP + MotionPathPlugin) — click a thumbnail to expand it full-frame, with a bounce on close. Autoplays every 4.5s.
showcaseComboboxDescription: Trigger + search in a popover (shadcn design without Radix/cmdk) — groups, icons, custom filter, configurable placement.
showcaseDecoratedCardDescription: 8 ready-to-use decorative variants — no imposed size, content dictates size.
showcaseEntityDetailBrowserDescription: Entity + list of browsable sub-items, detail panel and related-entity panel, all via props. Click the first lesson or the + button to see the trainer.
showcaseFieldsDescription: Single, multi-variant input field (outlined / filled / standard / kinetic).
showcaseFolderGalleryDescription: Generic interactive folder — 'items' accepts any React content. Two examples below: photos and profile cards.
showcaseGlassCardDescription: Standalone liquid glass effect (blur + distortion + highlights), used internally by Toast.
showcaseImageSwiperDescription: Swipeable card stack (stacked 3D effect, Tinder-style) — swipe a card left or right to send it to the back of the stack.
showcaseInteractiveSelectorDescription: Expanding-panel selector — click a panel to stretch it full-frame, the others collapse to a strip. Cascading entrance on load.
showcaseLayoutGridDescription: Card grid — click a card to stretch it full-frame (shared layout transition), a dark scrim appears behind it. Click the scrim again to close.
showcaseLiveOrbDescription: 3D sphere whose eyes follow the pointer (WebGL, CSS fallback without GPU) — material variants, free colors, pointer tracking and blinking can be turned off.
showcaseMenuDescription: Animated (GSAP) side navigation panel — configurable side: left or right.
showcaseMorphSelectDescription: Select whose trigger morphs into the panel (shared layout) — composable: MorphSelectTrigger / Value / Content / Item.
showcasePromptInputDescription: Assistant input area — model and effort choice, attachments, send with Enter. The onSubmit callback receives the text and metadata.
showcaseRecursiveErosionDescription: Animated particle-sphere background (sandboxed iframe) — light/dark mode, adjustable hue, saturation and brightness.
showcaseSelectDescription: Generic selection popover (compound component) — trigger + panel with search, avatar/initial fallback, fully customizable rendering.
showcaseSheetDescription: Draggable modal sheet, anchored top or bottom based on the side prop.
showcaseSplineSceneDescription: Full-frame Spline 3D scene (scene prop = .splinecode URL) — loaded on demand because the scene weighs ~1.3 MB.
showcaseTestimonialCardDescription: Swipeable testimonial stack (translucent glass) — swipe the front card left to send it to the back of the stack.
showcaseToastDescription: 'Liquid glass' notification, 3 variants: default (countdown), transfer (real progress), actions (customizable commands).
showcaseVerticalSliderDescription: Vertical auto-playing carousel (2s), navigation via a synced thumbnail rail.
showcaseWaterGlassDescription: "Water glass" panel for menus and popovers — alignment, width, header/footer slots. Positioned relative to its relative parent.
showcaseXboxSoundsDescription: Interface sound effects (Web Audio, no files) — click a button to play the sound; mute state is remembered.
